focus: RQ-1: per-skill split of routing prose versus machine data, with word counts, across the 16 AI Systems SKILL.md files
noveltyJustification: All 10 findings are new: the first measured breakdown of every routing section in the target repository.
keyQuestions: RQ-1: For each of the 16 skills, which parts of its routing section are agent-facing prose and which are machine data (assignment blocks, pseudocode, resource lists), and what is the word count of each part?

RQ-2: What loads these skills (OpenCode through opencode.json, Claude Code through .claude/, the Claude Project sync loop in 'AI Systems/z - Claude Project Sync Loop' and its hand-written knowledge files, and any other runtime), and does each loader load a file beside SKILL.md on its own?

RQ-3: Which check, benchmark gate or script in the AI Systems repository reads a SKILL.md routing section or a ROUTER.md, with file:line, and which of this repository's tools (package_skill.py, the router resolver) apply there?
RQ-4: How does each of the four existing ROUTER.md files classify against the new canon, and what does each need?

RQ-5: What is the per-skill migration design: target shape per skill, Claude Project knowledge-file changes, token saving per skill, and the order that avoids colliding with other sessions working in that repository?
answeredQuestions: RQ-1: For each of the 16 skills, which parts of its routing section are agent-facing prose and which are machine data (assignment blocks, pseudocode, resource lists), and what is the word count of each part?

label: The 16 routing sections hold 17,935 words: 13,130 machine data (73.2 percent) and 4,805 agent-facing prose (26.8 percent).
sk-barter-copywriter is the largest router: 3,814 routing words, 2,789 machine (73 percent) across 12 of 19 sub-blocks, 1,025 prose, and no fenced pseudocode at all.
sk-barter-deal-templates splits 1,835 routing words into 1,002 machine (two fences, one table, an 11-item Command Entry Points list) and 833 prose.
sk-media-editor is the lightest large skill at 605 routing words, 258 machine (43 percent) and 347 prose.
The Product Owner hub holds 485 routing words: 296 machine (a fenced route-resolution intro and an Outcomes assignment list) and 189 prose.

mcp-click-up (981w), mcp-figma (1199w) and mcp-code-mode (776w) are 100 percent machine data with zero prose, built from a loading-levels block, a Smart Router Pseudocode fence and a 20-row Operation-to-Tool Routing Table.
sk-create-figjam (964w, 30 prose), sk-sales-hubspot-automation (2067w, 76 prose) and sk-product-owner (598w, 190 prose) sit at 96 to 97 percent machine data.

sk-prompt-improver keeps 1,177 prose words beside 1,342 machine words, spread over Phase Detection, Routing Workflow, Natural-Language Topic Signals, Confidence Thresholds, Mode Mapping and Platform Detection.
sk-sales-communication is 1,622 routing words at 71 percent machine, including a 434-word Semantic Topic Registry carrying two fences.
The four Moneybird routing sections carry no machine data, and the three children that ship ROUTER.md are already in the post-move shape with 45 to 50 prose words each.
